b) Reference object: no fork or utensil is visible. The cantaloupe cubes are about 2-2.5 cm each, and the plate spans roughly 10-11 of those cubes across (about 25 cm). Consistent with the type estimate.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: No base layer like rice or grains is visible; the plate is mostly flat, so no significant hidden food. Items stay as listed.
